claims.claim: The Reviewer-specific module constructs one request through P3, invokes the selected provider at most once, and returns one P3-validated transient decision with immutable attribution.

The attempt maps input, transport, response, and identity failures to bounded typed errors, checks configured identity across the call, and keeps operational attribution outside P3 semantic fingerprints.
Independent mapping and JSON adapters enforce native response and attribution bounds, extract closed wrappers, retain no raw native payload, and receive only the exact P3 request.

The production module has no prohibited authority imports or second-call path. Focused fresh-fixture tests cover decisions, failure families, adapter grammar and bounds, identity invariance, and authority boundaries.
